claim: OPEN tripwire (ADR 0253 round 16 follow-up 7, 2026-10-03, which amends ADR 0162's founder addendum): only an owner removes a manager, so a manager removes staff only, and never an owner (unchanged). NOT BUILT at bd43d1487: MembersService.removeMember (members.service.ts:380-388) and TeamService.removeFromHouse (team.service.ts:1220-1231, reached from TeamService.deleteMember and from removeMember for a rostered person) refuse a manager only when the target is an owner, so a manager still removes a fellow manager, and two specs still say so (members.service.spec.ts:411 'lets a manager remove a manager or staff'; removal-only-that-house.spec.ts:392 'lets a manager remove a manager'). What this verify watches, exactly, comment-stripped and whitespace-normalised: [0] removeMember's body holds its owner guard once, pinned from the line before it through the start of the last-owner guard after it, with one ForbiddenException(, two actor.role and no quoted "manager" or "staff"; [1] the same for removeFromHouse's body (two ForbiddenException(), plus deleteMember still admitting at assertAccess(..., "manager") before it hands over; [2] both spec titles, read raw. It passes, and so fails the build as stale, as soon as any of these changes, and prints which index. It does not watch a guard placed outside those three bodies (a route decorator, assertMembership, a controller), or one inside them written without a role literal, actor.role or ForbiddenException; whoever builds the rule writes the positive check. A manager leaving the house themself (removeMember's selfLeave) was not part of the question. Mutation-tested 2026-10-03 on copies of the four files: exit 1 (open, holding) on this tree and on four controls (removeMember's guard rewrapped, whitespace only; a line comment and a block comment naming "manager", "staff", actor.role and ForbiddenException( inside the bodies; a spec body edited with its title kept); exit 0 on 13 mutants: removeMember's guard widened to managers, a new manager guard after its last-owner guard, a helper call taking actor.role, a staff-only guard throwing BadRequestException, the guard deleted, the method renamed (index 0); removeFromHouse's guard widened, a staff-only guard, a helper call, the guard deleted, deleteMember admitting owners only (index 1); either spec title renamed (index 2). Whoever builds it sets this row resolved with a verify that proves the refusal on both doors, and re-pins ADR-0162-OWNERS-REMOVE-OWNERS and ADR-0162-TEAM-REMOVE-OWNERS in CLAIMS.jsonl, whose claims still say a manager may remove a manager and whose verifies pin the same spec titles.
